speaker: Doctor
text: I need to clarify your symptoms: how long have you been experiencing fatigue and night sweats, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits or appetite? Also, where exactly is your abdominal pain located?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; given your weight loss, night sweats, and enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, I need to determine if this is an infectious or neoplastic process. Have you experienced any fever, cough, or difficulty swallowing? Also, can you describe the abdominal pain in more detail—is it sharp, dull, and does it radiate anywhere?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.
